summary: Turns the FM-1 into a C64 SID music machine with two emulated SID chips, a tracker and step sequencer, and GoatTracker 2 song compatibility.
features: Two SIDs (6581 or 8580) with adjustable chip character; three FX slots
STEP and GoatTracker-style TRACKER views with parameter locks
Saves and plays GoatTracker 2 .sng songs; plays PSID .sid tunes
LAB sound editor, 16 user sounds; imports SidStation and MIDIbox patches
MIDI CCs and NRPNs; optional Bluetooth MIDI; USB audio input
Browser library, song editor, screen mirror and song-to-MIDI tools
